children: said on Sunday it delivered more than 50,000 electric vehicles in October, the highest monthly total this year, as it ramps up production to meet its 2026 target.
Deliveries reached about 336,000 vehicles for the first 10 months after topping 30,000 units in August and 40,000 in September.
The company aims to deliver 550,000 vehicles in 2026. Its January-October deliveries represent about 61% of that goal.
